rawContent: @medpagetoday A1: the current estimates range from 20-60% of #WomenInMedicine experiencing harassment. The hierarchical structure, male dominated leaderships, lack of diversity all contribute to an environment that permits #sexualharassment #medpagelive #meToo
@arghavan_salles Definitely: the @theNASEM report delineates 3 components: 1) Gender Harassment 2) Sexual Coercion 3) Unwanted sexual attention #medpagelive #metoo https://t.co/ZiCvcB0Geb

@darakass @medpagetoday Unfortunately the current policies focus more on fending off liability than protecting & supporting the person reporting sexual harassment. Subsequently, fear of negative consequences for self deters reporting #medpagelive #meToo

@darakass @medpagetoday In a study of surgeons, we found that a fear of negative impact on career & fear of retribution were the strongest barriers to reporting; reflecting the need for policies that protect victims #medpagelive #MeToo https://t.co/sL9bG3IB6j

@DrSinhaEsq @BarbaraMcAneny @AmerMedicalAssn Thank you for joining in Dr. @BarbaraMcAneny ! Glad to see @AmerMedicalAssn ‘s commitment to rooting out inappropriate behavior from healthcare workplaces #TimesupHC @TIMESUPHC #medpagelive #meToo

@medpagetoday While there has been backlash in light of #MeToo (eg. well meaning men’s fear of mentoring women) IMHO, the solution lies in effective communication. If someone tells you your action makes them uncomfortable, introspect & don’t repeat that behavior #medpagelive #MeToo

@medpagetoday However, this👆🏻does NOT apply to sexual harassment. What constitutes harassment is not ambiguous (make yourself aware if you already aren’t) and don’t indulge in harassing behavior. Treating everyone with dignity & respect should not have to be taught #medpagelive #MeToo

@arghavan_salles @gebhard_roberta I am so sorry to hear that has been your experience. We as a system need a #culturalchange that protects victims & punishes the perpetrators not the victim/their supporters #Medpagelive #MeToo

@medpagetoday Apart from psychological trauma, anxiety, depression and PTSD, sexual harassment is linked with long term physical health consequences (eg hypertension) #MedPageLive #MeToo https://t.co/zfrUAKfboO

@medpagetoday It also leads to victims switching institutions/leaving their profession all together that thwarts progress in science & healthcare. We are doing injustice to our patients by losing a chunk of talented skilled healthcare workers/scientists. #MedpageLive #MeToo
